It states triviality of the centralizer of any open pi-prime in pi, then names that centralizer and discusses its image in the indicated Gamma group. The inserted sauf erreur before the proposed strengthening is the author’s own qualification, separately from the later parenthesized sauf erreur accompanying the injectivity claim. Both are retained as source statements, not added editorial caveats.

He then claims, with the written qualification sauf erreur, that the exterior-action homomorphism is injective, reducing to transcendence degree 1 and an algebraic curve.
